question: Does an officially confirmed starting lineup add out-of-sample predictive value beyond the same-time full-match 1X2 market?
candidate: Three-class multinomial logistic residual on log normalized market probabilities with L2=10, plus fixed team-level difference in number of players with at least 450 prior officially recorded minutes in the preceding 365 days. Never infer a missing lineup or minutes as zero.
comparison: Same fixture, decision time, 1X2 product, full odds vector, outcome and settlement: market, no-fact offset-only baseline, candidate; frozen operating picks separately if actually available, with coverage reported. No invented operating predictions.
identity_and_evidence: Unique official fixture, stable teams/player IDs, period and product, kickoff and actual receipt timestamps, preserved official bytes and SHA256 with provenance; independent receipt authentication distinguished from internal logging. Confirmed lineup only; probable is excluded. Claim publication is not receipt. Quotes and all features received by decision and decision <= kickoff minus 30 minutes. Outcomes available strictly before training cutoff, with recorded receipt or conservative explicitly labeled availability. Reject duplicated source document bytes within event and distinct ambiguous identity matches.
separate_context: Promotion/playoff phase is a predecision official categorical field; rest is days since last completed match with evidence available before decision. Record both separately as audit strata, not candidate inputs. Missing phase or rest is unknown. Do not derive them from final standings or target result.
split: Prospective previously unseen eligible fixtures only after this protocol commit: chronological 60% train, 20% validation, 20% holdout by kickoff day with same day kept together; train labels available before validation starts, validation labels available before holdout starts; no overlap. No repeated selection or tuning on holdout.
gate: Do not fit or report performance until at least 300 eligible distinct fixtures, at least 180 train, 60 validation, 60 holdout, and at least 30 holdout fixtures with confirmed complete lineups; report otherwise blocked_data. Fit once on train, select candidate only if validation paired logloss improves at least 0.005 against market and no-fact baseline; otherwise stop and leave holdout unexamined. If selected, freeze and evaluate holdout once. Report paired daily-block bootstrap 95% intervals, n, coverage, accuracy, ROI, multiclass logloss, Brier and daily closing drawdown; profits flat one unit, odds and void settlement identical. Statistical uncertainty and executable-price limitations remain explicit. No promotion follows from this protocol.
safety_tests: Execute Python checks of cutoff and receipt leakage, same-document duplicates, target/future label poisoning and settlement arithmetic using isolated synthetic cases before any real fit; hash and preserve exact code and inputs. No operation, wallet or deployment changes.
